select isnull(cl.client_name, 'Z기타') as client_name ,isnull(pd.prod_md_code, 'ETC') as prod_md_code ,isnull(pd.prod_md_name, '기타') as prod_md_name , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT001' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty1 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT002' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty2 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT003' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty3 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT004' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty4 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT005' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty5 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT006' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty6 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT007' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty7 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT008' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty8 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT009' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty9 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT010' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty10 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code = 'PT011' then a.prod_qty else 0 end) as qty11 , sum(case when pd.prod_md_code not in ( 'PT001', 'PT002', 'PT003', 'PT004', 'PT005', 'PT006', 'PT007', 'PT008', 'PT009', 'PT010', 'PT011' ) then prod_qty else 0 end) as etc_qty , sum(prod_qty) as total_qty from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a left join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b on b.work_batch_id = a.work_batch_id left join TB_WORK_ORDER_MST c on c.work_order_id = a.work_order_id left join tb_client_mst cl on cl.client_id = c.client_id join tb_item_detail id on id.item_cd = a.item_cd join tb_prod_type pd on pd.prod_md_code = id.prod_md_type where a.proc_status = '52' and a.proc_order_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-09-01'
group by cl.client_name, pd.prod_md_code, pd.prod_md_name
